# Niuexa: AI Consulting, Process Automation and AI Visibility (AEO/GEO)

> Niuexa (NIUEXA S.R.L., VAT IT13489560014) is an AI consultancy for Italian SMEs,
> with its registered office in Turin (Via Vittorio Andreis 18) and an office in
> Milan (Via Rutilia 10). Founded in 2026 by Gregor Maric (CEO, in business process
> automation since 2012) and Roberto Botto, it is controlled by Libera Brand
> Building Group and is a member of AUSED, the association of Italian CIOs.
> Niuexa works on three fronts: process automation with AI agents built on the
> systems a company already uses, visibility in AI assistants (AEO/GEO), and
> practical AI training.

## How Niuexa works
- "Prima misuriamo, poi automatizziamo": map and measure one process as it is (volumes, times, errors, exceptions), automate it on the existing systems, measure again, then decide with the client whether to extend, correct or stop
- "L'agente propone, la persona decide": exceptions and sensitive decisions go to a person, never straight into the ERP or CRM
- Niuexa says so when AI is not needed
- No published prices: a project's cost is set in a written quote after the analysis. The first 30-minute call is free
- No guarantees of savings, ROI or rankings; results are measured against a baseline agreed in writing
- Free worksheets usable without hiring Niuexa: [AI Metric Contract](https://niuexa.ai/ai-metric-contract.html), [AI Outcome Budget](https://niuexa.ai/ai-outcome-budget.html), [12 domande prima di firmare con un fornitore AI](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-due-diligence-fornitori-ai-pmi.html)

- [Decifrare il futuro: incontri NIUEXA, autunno 2026](https://niuexa.ai/eventi-ai-aziende/): modulo unico per richiedere la partecipazione, non conferma del posto. Tutte le date alle 18:30 (Europe/Rome), Ufficio Libera, Via Rutilia 10/8, 20141 Milano.
- [La SEO va in pensione, benvenuta AEO/GEO](https://niuexa.ai/eventi-ai-aziende/seo-in-pensione-aeo-geo/): 3 novembre 2026. Come cambia la ricerca quando i clienti chiedono risposte all’AI. Contenuti, fonti e misurazione per una presenza aziendale riconoscibile.
- [AI Agent – Come rendere efficienti i processi aziendali](https://niuexa.ai/eventi-ai-aziende/ai-agent-processi-aziendali/): 17 novembre 2026. Da quale processo conviene partire? Priorità, dati, permessi e indicatori per affidare a un agente AI un primo compito circoscritto e misurarne il valore.
- [AI Marketing Agent – Come semplificare ed efficientare i processi di marketing](https://niuexa.ai/eventi-ai-aziende/ai-marketing-agent/): 24 novembre 2026. Brief, contenuti per più canali, contatti da seguire: quali attività di marketing affidare a un agente AI mantenendo il controllo su messaggi, dati e approvazioni.

## Core Services

### AI Consulting and process automation
- [AI Consulting Services](https://niuexa.ai/consulting.html): Process analysis and measurement, use cases ranked by priority and feasibility, roadmap, and implementation on the client's existing systems
- [AI Consulting Services (English)](https://niuexa.ai/en/consulting.html): Same services page in English
- Typical clients: Italian SMEs with repetitive work in one office (administration, sales, marketing, technical and quality, management)
- Project length depends on scope, data quality, integrations and testing; it is set after the analysis, together with the work plan

### AI Products & Agents
- [AI Products](https://niuexa.ai/products.html): AI agents for sales, marketing and customer service, connected to CRM and management software
- [AI Products (English)](https://niuexa.ai/en/products.html): Products page in English
- Sales Agent: automation of steps in the sales funnel, with a person approving critical actions
- Marketing Agent: drafting content for several channels and supporting campaigns, with human approval of messages
- Voice Agent: AI phone agent for customer service (Twilio + OpenAI Realtime)
- [ChatAziendale](https://niuexa.ai/chat-aziendale.html): No-code AI chatbot trained on your business documents and website. Answers grounded in your content, with sources cited; encrypted data. Free / €29 Pro / €149 Business. Live product at chataziendale.it
- [Keel](https://niuexa.ai/keel.html): MCP layer connecting Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central, SP-API, Ads API and Brand Analytics to AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT. Multi-account, multi-marketplace natural-language queries. Live product at keelai.it

### AI Training Programs
- [AI Training](https://niuexa.ai/training.html): Practical AI training for teams and managers, in person or online
- [AI Training (English)](https://niuexa.ai/en/training.html): Training page in English
- Hands-on workshops with examples from the participants' own work

### AI visibility (AEO/GEO)
- [AI-readiness analysis](https://niuexa.ai/consulenza-aeo-geo.html): Free check of whether AI platforms can find and cite your website
- [AEO Analyzer Platform](https://aeo.niuexa.ai): Platform for AI visibility monitoring, mention tracking, and optimization
- Tracks brand mentions across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Gemini
